semantics.root: A `🧬️mutations` directory whose direct children are mutation owner directories.
semantics.holdsDescriptors: True when each direct child owner of the root must carry its own canonical payload descriptor. Fixture mirrors and codec projections (`🚪️io/<representation>/🧬️mutations`) consume the schema-side owner and hold none.
semantics.consumerRootPatterns: Glob view of the same rule: a root matching any pattern is a consumer root.

cases.note: the schema facet owns the descriptor of every direct mutation owner
a surface-state lane has its own schema facet
the fixture mirror consumes the schema-side owner
the binary codec projects the schema-side owner onto its wire
the text codec projects the schema-side owner onto its grammar
the SQLite storage projects the schema-side owner onto its tables
a named test owner keeps its own descriptors
